title: Hypocritical
summary: HYPOCRIT'ICAL, a. Simulating; counterfeiting a religions character; assuming a false and deceitful appearance; applied to persons. 1. Dissembling; concealing one's real character or motives.2. Proceed

inlines.v: HYPOCRIT'ICAL, a. Simulating; counterfeiting a religions character; assuming a false and deceitful appearance; applied to persons. 1. Dissembling; concealing one's real character or motives.2. Proceeding from hypocrisy, or marking hypocrisy; as a hypocritical face or look.
